description: Collect and manage customer feedback in Canny. Read boards, posts, comments, votes, users and tags, create and update posts, move them through statuses, comment and vote as your users, and write, publish or schedule changelog entries. Triggers start a workflow when a new post arrives or a post changes status.

canny_new_post_trigger.description: Runs when someone posts feedback or a feature request in Canny.

output.category: The post's category, if it has one.
output.id: The post's id, for 'Get post' or 'Change post status'.
output.title: The post's title.

parameters.description: Only run for posts on this board (its id, from 'List boards'). Leave blank to run for every board.
parameters.name: board_id

canny_post_status_changed_trigger.description: Runs when a post in Canny moves to a new status, such as planned or complete.

output.changer_id: The Canny id of who changed it.
output.changer_name: The name of who changed it.
output.comment: The comment left with the change, if any.
output.status: The status the post moved to.

parameters.description: Only run for status changes on this board (its id, from 'List boards'). Leave blank to run for every board.
parameters.name: board_id
